pages.title: Game design
pages.markdown:
# Pitch
You play a courier robot climbing a tower of floating islands to deliver the last package before the storm.

## Camera and controls
- Mouse / right stick turns the camera
- WASD / left stick moves relative to the camera

## Scale
One Blender unit is one meter. The robot is 1.8 m tall.

## Demo scope
- [ ] One island, 5 minutes of play
- [ ] One enemy type (drone)
- [ ] The delivery point at the top

pages.title: Blender to Unity checklist
pages.markdown:
- [ ] Scale applied (Ctrl+A > Scale)
- [ ] Rotation applied
- [ ] Origin at the feet
- [ ] UV map present
- [ ] Under 30k triangles for the player
- [ ] Export as FBX with -Z forward, Y up (the add-on does this)
